acceptanceCriteria: The package passes under the gate's TMPDIR on darwin, or each affected test skips with a documented skip that names the environment requirement (protected ancestors, socket path length).
The root cause of protected-authority-unavailable under /private/tmp is named (fixture or product), with a test that distinguishes them.
body:
Suspected defect, root cause not diagnosed. Reported 2026-10-05 by the pstack-claude agent optimization session; pre-existing on origin/main and it makes `make gate` fail on this host (Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1). Not caused by the V1-0750/0751/0325 batch.

Repro: `TMPDIR=/private/tmp/claude-501/td GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/authoritystore/`. TestEvidenceFilesystemAuditRejectsTamperingAndExtraAccess (evidence_darwin_test.go:138 'valid: protected-authority-unavailable', also :149), TestEvidenceRecheckDetectsReplacementAndCancellation and TestMemoSuccessCannotReplaceFinalViewAudit fail with protected-authority-unavailable. Deterministic on origin/main ee925a4b and 8a35775a, c0a8b4ba and batch 2c36814d.

With the default long TMPDIR (/private/var/folders/...), TestDarwinReciprocalSocketWitness instead fails with 'bind: invalid argument' (unix socket path over the length limit). So no TMPDIR passes the whole package on this host.

Hypothesis: the fixture's t.TempDir root fails the evidence audit's ownership/mode checks under /private/tmp (sticky world-writable ancestors). Related but distinct: V1-0753 (tasks/store PSR, symlinked TMPDIR ancestor), V1-0601 (MTP socket path length), V1-0033 (completed ctime witnesses).

completion.reason: Delivered on main ae3b418152fe4c42f52ac7cfdc16ecc12159607e via batch beamfall/corvint#1411 (lane #1400); CI green on that commit (runs 39621556421,39618615648). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 86cf197d8cb1b2d290b7fb20d5ed20eb6c71f9ef40cc0c4b513592752281563b.

title: tests (suspected): internal/authoritystore darwin tests fail under every TMPDIR on Darwin 25.6.0 (protected-authority-unavailable, or socket bind: invalid argument)
